data.name: label1.Text
data.value: The Rags Player is designed to provide an entertaining, simple method to play RAGS games. There are several interactive regions of the RAGS player indicated below. You move your player through the game with the directional compass rose. You can execute room actions by right clicking on the current room. You can run actions on your player by right clicking on your portrait, and of course interact with game objects by right clicking on characters and objects. Some useful commands: F8-QuickSave F9-QuickLoad
